newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shrs end off, CANTV tunnel vision prevails.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shrs end off, CANTV tunnel vision prevails.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off on scant investor interest, traders said, with no sustained rebound expected until the CANTV share issue is completed.
"I like shares at the moment, but moreso after the CANTV issue is settled," said Profimerca broker Miguel Gonzalez. "There was no volume, no bidders today."

The market was unmoved by a 204-basis-point drop in benchmark six-month Central Bank TEM yields, traders said. The bolsa's index closed down 0.97 percent at 5,939.75 points. Among traded issues, 27 fell, seven rose and four ended flat.
A total of 13.1 million shares changed hands worth 3.1 billion bolivars ($6.6 million).

Among the day's leading trades, benchmark Electricidad de Caracas fell 10.00 bolivars to end at 530.00 as 2.4 million shares traded. Over four million shares of Corimon preferred B series also traded, with the stock closing off 0.50 bolivars at 9.50.
Corimon's B shares are the fruit of a financial restructuring that turned its former stock into A shares, and its securitized debt into B shares.
